summary: The proposal has a defined problem, objectives, and planned architecture, but it requires significant revision before submission. The missing abstract and structural gap in the introduction are substantial, and the Problem section should be separated more clearly from the proposed solution; additional heading, caption, and prose revisions would improve clarity and presentation.

findings.title: Missing Abstract section
findings.description: The proposal does not contain an Abstract section. Add an abstract of approximately one-third to one-half page summarizing the problem, motivation, objectives, and planned approach.

findings.title: Problem section proposes a solution
findings.description: The Problem section introduces a proposed solution and claims its expected benefit. Remove this sentence from the Problem section and describe only the existing problem and its consequences; move any proposed platform description to the Motivation or Objectives section.

locations.quote: A self-service platform that arms the workfow engine of Keycloak with an expiry date at grant time would end this accumulation.

findings.title: Missing introductory text before Section 1 subsections
findings.description: Section 1 begins directly with subsection 1.1 and has no introductory paragraph. Add a short introduction after the “1 Introduction” heading that previews the setting and existing infrastructure discussed in the subsections.

findings.title: Objective heading contains double verbs
findings.description: Objective 2 uses two coordinated action verbs in its heading. Choose one primary verb; for example, change the heading to “Implement Connectors with Expiry” and describe the design decisions in the subsection.

locations.quote: Design and Implement Connectors with Expiry

findings.title: Figure 2 caption is not sufficiently informative
findings.description: Figure 2 has a generic caption that does not explain the architecture, the responsibilities of the depicted components, or the meaning of the interfaces and connections. Replace it with a longer, informative caption describing the main components, external systems, data flows, and the role of expiry-driven deprovisioning.

locations.section: Objective — Design and Implement Connectors with Expiry

findings.title: Minor prose and style issues
findings.description: Address two minor style issues: rewrite the passive construction with the responsible actor as the subject, for example, “The implementation meets the objective when…” or “The evaluation considers the objective met when…”; and replace the contraction “doesn’t” with “does not.”

locations.section: Structure Resources as an Inheriting Tree
locations.quote: The objective is met when a grant on a folder with bindable descendants yields exactly provisioning commands and a resource added later inherits the grant without a new request.
The current process doesn’t scale and is the worst bottleneck of the chair.
